definitions.explanation: The age at which employees are required to retire from a company, typically 60-65 in Japan. Upon reaching this age, employees leave their regular positions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{定年|ていねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: My father reaches retirement age next year.

examples.japanese: {定年|ていねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧65⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げられた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。
examples.english: The retirement age was raised to 65.

examples.japanese: {定年|ていねん}{後|ご}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people are continuing to work after retirement age.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{定|てい} (fixed, set) + ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (age, year)

Literally "set age" - the predetermined age for retirement.

RETIREMENT AGE IN JAPAN:
- Traditional: 60⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧
- Current trend: 65⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ (due to aging society)
- Some companies: 70⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ or later

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{定年退職|ていねんたいしょく}→定年退職：16450_teinentaishoku⟧ - mandatory retirement
- ⟦{早期退職|そうきたいしょく}→早期退職：08070_soukitaishoku⟧ - early retirement
- ⟦{再雇用|さいこよう}→再雇用：16462_saikoyou⟧ - rehiring (after retirement age)
- ⟦{嘱託|しょくたく}→嘱託：17155_shokutaku⟧ - contract employee (post-retirement)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {定年|ていねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ - to reach retirement age
- {定年|ていねん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ - to work until retirement
- {定年|ていねん}⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧ - extending retirement age
- {定年|ていねん}{引上|ひきあ}げ - raising retirement age

CULTURAL NOTE:
With Japan's aging population and labor shortage, many companies are:
- Raising {定年|ていねん} to 65 or 70
- Offering ⟦{再雇用|さいこよう}→再雇用：16462_saikoyou⟧ programs
- Eliminating mandatory retirement altogether
